name: DC Rivals HyperCoaster
description: The tallest, fastest and longest hypercoaster in the Southern Hemisphere — DC Rivals stands 61 metres tall and reaches 115 km/h across 1,436 metres of spectacular steel track. Features an extraordinary backwards-facing rear car for riders who want the most extreme rear-view experience. The undisputed crown jewel of Movie World. Min 130cm.

name: Superman Escape
description: A launched indoor coaster that blasts riders from 0 to 100 km/h in 2 seconds through a spectacular Superman-themed indoor layout combining complete darkness, visual effects and high-speed manoeuvres. One of the most thrilling launch coasters in Australia. Min 110cm.

name: Arkham Asylum Coaster
description: An intense Vekoma SLC inverted coaster themed to DC villain Arkham Asylum — riders hang beneath the track through 5 inversions at 80 km/h in a relentlessly intense experience. One of the most iconic attractions at Movie World Australia. Min 130cm.

name: The Flash: Vertical Velocity
description: A Premier Rides launched shuttle coaster that fires riders forward and backward through a vertical spike at 100 km/h — delivering a heart-stopping top hat and near-vertical descent. Min 120cm.

name: Doomsday Destroyer
description: A giant 65-metre drop tower that hoists riders to the top before free-falling at terrifying speed. The tallest drop tower in Queensland and one of the most intense tower rides in Australian theme parks. Min 130cm.

name: Wild West Falls Adventure Ride
description: A spectacular log flume adventure through the Wild West culminating in a breathtaking 14-metre drop — one of the best log flume experiences in Australian theme parks with impressive theming and a guaranteed soaking. Min 100cm.

name: Green Lantern Coaster
description: A classic stand-up coaster themed to DC superhero Green Lantern — riders stand upright through a layout of inversions and high-speed turns. One of the most unusual coaster formats in Australia. Min 110cm.

name: Batman Adventure
description: An immersive Batman-themed indoor dark ride combining stunning theming, special effects and atmospheric storytelling. One of the most elaborately designed indoor attractions at Movie World. Suitable for most ages.

name: Scooby-Doo Spooky Coaster
description: A beloved family indoor coaster through a darkened haunted house with Scooby-Doo theming — thrilling enough for older children and gentle enough for families. One of the most popular family attractions at Movie World. Min 90cm.

name: Hollywood Stunt Driver Show
description: The most spectacular live stunt show in Australian theme parks — professional stunt drivers recreate iconic Hollywood car chases, explosions and pyrotechnic sequences in a purpose-built arena. Suitable for all ages.

name: Police Academy Stunt Show
description: A hilarious comedy stunt show featuring bumbling police recruits in a slapstick action spectacular with stunts, water effects and audience participation. A Movie World classic and firm favourite with families. Suitable for all ages.

name: Wicked Witch of the West Ride
description: A spinning family dark ride through the magical world of Oz featuring the iconic Wicked Witch — colourful scenes, spinning vehicles and gentle thrills. Min 90cm.

name: Marvin the Martian Ride
description: A fun and gentle family ride themed to Looney Tunes character Marvin the Martian — perfect for young children visiting Movie World for their first theme park experience. Suitable for all ages.
